name: When an owner who lives in the unit moves out, the owner's dependents move out with them
title: SC-08-12-11 When an owner who lives in the unit moves out, the owner's dependents move out with them
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given Unit "A Blok 14" is OWNER_OCCUPIED with Owner on record and two household members
When the Site Manager moves the owner out
Then the unit is VACANT and the live household roster is empty
And the owner remains the owner on record and the dependents are archived against the closed owner session
